profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at iboss
profile.summary: I am a passionate and tenacious computer programmer who strives to overcome every challenge.  I have intangible leadership and work ethic skills from my experience as a captain and four year starter on Stonehill's NCAA Division II Varsity Football Team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing a C++ client/server message platform application 
- Created a help platform web application, hosted on a JBoss Web Server, using JavaScript (Bootstrap, JQuery), HTML 5, CSS 3
- Converted a Java-based legacy system into a new architecture system as part of work on an Agile Scrum team
- Designed multithreading Java swing widgets

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with Agile Scrum team to develop a Java desktop application for antennas and radios
- Merged code using source control software (ClearCase)
- Loaded and tested new voice client/server software on a mobile military unit
- Participated in weekly meetings to review current and new tasks

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
- Represented computer science department as official tutor for college’s writing center
- Explained and practiced computer science concepts with students in all course levels for 4+ hours each week
